name: Confidentiality
text: The Receiving Party shall maintain the confidentiality of all Confidential Information and shall not disclose or use such information except as permitted under this Agreement.

legal_basis.note: Confidentiality agreements narrowly targeting specific info are valid

source: Indian Contract Act, 1872; IT Act, 2000; SEBI Regulations, 2015
